# Components

This layer contains components used to build and customize the Excalidraw application, including the main menu, sidebar, footer, and welcome screen.

## Key components

| File | Purpose | Main definitions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`excalidraw-app/components/AI.tsx`](../../excalidraw-app/components/AI.tsx) | Exports AI components and renders diagrams. | `AIComponents` |
| [`excalidraw-app/components/AppFooter.tsx`](../../excalidraw-app/components/AppFooter.tsx) | Exports and renders the application footer. | `AppFooter` |
| [`excalidraw-app/components/AppMainMenu.tsx`](../../excalidraw-app/components/AppMainMenu.tsx) | Exports and renders the application main menu. | `AppMainMenu` |
| [`excalidraw-app/components/AppSidebar.scss`](../../excalidraw-app/components/AppSidebar.scss) | Styles the application sidebar. |  |
| [`excalidraw-app/components/AppSidebar.tsx`](../../excalidraw-app/components/AppSidebar.tsx) | Exports and renders the application sidebar. | `AppSidebar`, `SidebarPromoCopy` |
| [`excalidraw-app/components/AppWelcomeScreen.tsx`](../../excalidraw-app/components/AppWelcomeScreen.tsx) | Exports and renders the application welcome screen. | `AppWelcomeScreen` |
| [`excalidraw-app/components/DebugCanvas.tsx`](../../excalidraw-app/components/DebugCanvas.tsx) | Exports and renders debug canvas components. | `saveDebugState`, `debugRenderer`, `loadSavedDebugState`, `isVisualDebuggerEnabled`, `DebugFooter`, `default` |
| [`excalidraw-app/components/EncryptedIcon.tsx`](../../excalidraw-app/components/EncryptedIcon.tsx) | Exports and renders an encrypted icon. | `EncryptedIcon` |
| [`excalidraw-app/components/ExcalidrawPlusPromoBanner.tsx`](../../excalidraw-app/components/ExcalidrawPlusPromoBanner.tsx) | Exports and renders the Excalidraw Plus promo banner. | `ExcalidrawPlusPromoBanner` |
| [`excalidraw-app/components/ExportToExcalidrawPlus.tsx`](../../excalidraw-app/components/ExportToExcalidrawPlus.tsx) | Exports and renders the export to Excalidraw Plus functionality. | `exportToExcalidrawPlus`, `ExportToExcalidrawPlus` |
| [`excalidraw-app/components/TopErrorBoundary.tsx`](../../excalidraw-app/components/TopErrorBoundary.tsx) | Manages error boundaries for the Excalidraw application. | `TopErrorBoundary` |

## How it works

- **AppFooter.tsx:** Renders the footer, which includes copyright and other information.
- **ExportToExcalidrawPlus.tsx:** Provides functionality to export drawings to Excalidraw Plus.

## Configuration

- Environment variables: `VITE_APP_AI_BACKEND`, `VITE_APP_PLUS_APP`, `VITE_APP_PLUS_LP`.
- Configuration files: `excalidraw-app/vite.config.mts`.
